fields.name: incident_id
fields.description: {"value":"The unique alpha-numeric value assigned to the incident in the SIT209 database. This value follows a format where the first two letters indicate the state, the next letters are the incident agency, and the last digits are local agency assigned.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: fire_name
fields.description: {"value":"Name of the incident. As shown in the published IMSR PDF file but in some cases, underscores are replaced with spaces and 'Title' case is imposed on the name.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: post_date_isoformat
fields.description: {"value":"Reflects the date of the incident record and associated information as was shown on the IMSR PDF date of publication. In ISO date format of YYYYMMDD.  For example: the IMSR posted on July 11, 2023  would get a post_date_isoformat value of 20230711.","fieldValueType":"orderedOrRanked"}

fields.name: IsLatest
fields.description: {"value":"Populated with an 'x' for querying for the most recent 'post_date_isoformat' date data. An 'x' is provided in the field if the record represents the most recent information provided by the NICC for their IMSR incidents. Otherwise, the field will be blank/null.","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: size
fields.description: {"value":"The incident size in acres as posted on the IMSR publication.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: x100pct
fields.description: {"value":"A “c” will designate when an incident is 100 percent contained or fire management objectives have been completed. ","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: {"value":"The point of origin latitude (y coordinate) in decimal degrees. ","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: {"value":"The point of origin longitude (x coordinate) in decimal degrees.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: UniqueFireIdentifier
fields.description: {"value":"Derived from a reconfiguration of the incident_id field. A code used within the interagency incident management community and defined by the National Wildfire Coordinating Group (NWCG) to uniquely identify a particular incident.\nFormat is yyyy-SSUUUU-xxxxxx: yyyy=calendar year, SSUUUU=unit identifier (5 or 6 characters), xxxxxx=local incident identifier (6 to 10 characters). \nFor more info on the NWCG data standard: https://www.nwcg.gov/sites/default/files/stds/unique_fire_id/definition.pdf","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: initial_imsr_date
fields.description: {"value":"The date of the initial source SIT209 incident record used to track the incident in the source files provided by the NICC.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: new_to_imsr
fields.description: {"value":"Identifies if an incident is new to the IMSR (populated with a 'y') or not (null) as of the 'IMSR Post Date (ISO Format)'.","fieldValueType":"binary"}
